protocol.experiment: experiment_1 — TPE · KDE+REINFORCE inversion · Lorentzian-width (TPA) · synthetic benchmark
protocol.benchmark: 14 synthetic exps (1nW/3nW × Trans05-100), true params from Gregor's fits; targets at true values, SYNTH_SEED=12345 (identical across trials); deterministic runs SEED=42
protocol.objective: combined relative MSE of (mu,gamma) over 28 per-exp errors + sampling SE; lower is better; no Fisher
protocol.space: space.json — 5 tunables: sigma_ref [5,25], lr_mu [5,30], lr_gamma [0.2,1.0], gamma_anneal [0,0.75], clip [5,20]; n_runs/n_iter fixed (not tuned)
protocol.runtime_cap: n_runs*n_iter <= 40000 (~3.5h full budget). TEST PHASE 2026-09-03: fixed cheap budget 100x100 (~1h/trial) to exercise the loop; feasibility inert
fixed_structural: mu LR linear decay no floor
protocol.authority: hyperparameters = agent's call within protocol; structural changes (score/likelihood/model) need Anuar's OK
open_decisions: budget 3.5h vs reduced benchmark vs tighter space
re-run baseline through harness for same-machinery anchor
protocol.test_phase_note: TEST PHASE 2026-09-03: cheap model budget (n_runs=n_iter=100, ~1h/trial) to exercise AG-HYPOPT; baseline_17g anchor is at 200x200, so absolute objectives are not directly comparable until re-anchored at the new budget

trials.summary: Baseline: z-form gamma-score config (17g), computed from the executed 17g notebook (synthetic, 14 exps). mu rel-RMSE 3.6%, gamma rel-RMSE 4.3%. Objective to beat.
trials.key_insight: The 1/H^2 amplification was the gamma disease; one-power-of-bandwidth + fixed H_REF cures it on synthetic. Remaining: 3nW T05 gamma outlier (+2.14), mu bias at 3nW high-T.

trials.summary: Machinery test PASS at the 100x100 budget: MSE 0.0022 ± 0.0013, μ/γ rel-RMSE 4.2%/5.2%, only the Trans05 endpoints outlying; loss not comparable to the 200x200 baseline_17g anchor yet.
trials.key_insight: The simplified packed objective + trial loop is proven end-to-end and loop-ready; loss numbers only become meaningful once re-anchored at a matched budget.
